agent_summary:
Lane 77 (Identity management, OWASP Juice Shop at juice.lab.test) — all 5 WSTG-IDNT items tested read-only; writes not permitted so dynamic registration/modification was examined but not executed.

Findings by item:
- IDNT-01 Role definitions (done): Observed roles admin/deluxe (and role-descriptive accounts ciso@, accountant@) via unauthenticated /rest/memories, which leaks full User objects (username, email, password hash, role). SPA exposes role-gated routes /administration and /accounting. Authorization boundary is consistent for data objects: /api/Users, /api/SecurityAnswers, /api/SecurityQuestions/{id}, /api/Cards/1, /api/Addresss/1, /rest/basket/1, /b2b/v2/orders, /rest/order-history all return 401 unauthenticated, while /rest/admin/application-configuration is world-readable.
- IDNT-02 Registration process (done): OPTIONS /api/Users advertises POST — anonymous self-service registration is enabled; security questions come from a public fixed list (/api/SecurityQuestions, 14 entries); /rest/captcha is a trivial arithmetic captcha; i18n bundle references INVALID_PASSWORD_LENGTH (client-side password length check). No email-verification step evident. Actual submission not performed (read-only).
- IDNT-03 Account provisioning (done): Self-service provisioning only, no admin approval; User model exposes a privileged "role" field. Recorded a HIGH lead: potential mass-assignment privilege escalation (register as admin) to be validated with a controlled write by an authorized tester.
- IDNT-04 Enumeration & guessable accounts (done): /rest/user/security-question?email= is a clear unauthenticated enumeration oracle — existing accounts return a question object, non-existent return {} (len 2). Confirmed across admin, jim, support, mc.safesearch, bender, ciso, accountant, bjoern@owasp.org, J12934, wurstbrot, amy, morty, stan, emma (exist) vs lisa, chris.pike, eric, john (absent). /rest/memories and /api/Feedbacks also leak valid account identifiers.
- IDNT-05 Username policy (done): Weak/unenforced — /rest/memories shows a user with empty username (""), usernames are optional and not unique; registration does not require a username.

Additional lead recorded: unauthenticated directory listing at /encryptionkeys (medium). Pre-existing recon leads (security-question enumeration, /rest/memories exposure, verbose errors, /ftp null-byte bypass, open redirect, /metrics) were observed again and are owned by other lanes.

Coverage: 121 read-only requests across API model endpoints, REST identity endpoints, /ftp and other directory listings, SPA bundle (main.js), and static assets. Reachable unauthenticated endpoints include /api/Products,/api/Quantitys,/api/Recycles,/api/Deliverys,/api/Feedbacks(list),/rest/products/*,/rest/user/security-question,/rest/memories,/rest/captcha,/rest/track-order,/rest/admin/application-configuration,/rest/admin/application-version,/rest/languages,/metrics,/ftp,/support/logs,/encryptionkeys. Nothing requiring writes was attempted; the role mass-assignment hypothesis is left for the write/authz lane.

leads.title: [agent] Open self-service registration with privileged role field present in User model

detail.text: OPTIONS /api/Users advertises POST and anonymous registration is enabled. The User model (exposed via unauthenticated /rest/memories) contains a "role" field with values such as "admin" and "deluxe". In OWASP Juice Shop this is the classic mass-assignment privilege-escalation (register with role=admin). Could not be confirmed in this read-only lane; an authorized tester should attempt a controlled POST /api/Users with a role parameter on a throwaway account to validate.

GET http://juice.lab.test/encryptionkeys returns HTTP 200 with an HTML directory listing (~7.9KB) without authentication, exposing cryptographic key files for browsing/download. Similar to the already-reported /ftp and /support/logs listings. Relevant to the info/config lanes.
